Places to go deeper than this lesson, or to check a citation yourself before it goes in a
real Lakeshore document. Each was checked and loading at the time this page was written.

- **[21 CFR 211.68, Cornell Legal Information Institute](https://www.law.cornell.edu/cfr/text/21/211.68)**
  — the regulatory text quoted in this lesson, in Cornell's free, citable, plain-text CFR mirror.
  Use this when you need to hand someone the regulation itself without an eCFR login or PDF.

- **[21 CFR 210.2, Cornell Legal Information Institute](https://www.law.cornell.edu/cfr/text/21/210.2)**
  — the supplementation clause that lets a drug-manufacturing section like 211.68 reach a blood
  establishment's computer systems. Read it alongside 211.68 any time someone asks "why does a
  drug regulation apply to us at all."

- **[FDA guidance page: Blood Establishment Computer System Validation in the User's Facility](https://www.fda.gov/regulatory-information/search-fda-guidance-documents/blood-establishment-computer-system-validation-users-facility)**
  — FDA's own guidance-database listing for the document this course quotes throughout (final,
  April 2013, CBER). Use this page to confirm you're citing the current, final version, and to
  download the PDF directly from FDA rather than a mirror.

- **[ISPE: GAMP 5 (Second Edition)](https://ispe.org/publications/guidance-documents/gamp-5-guide-2nd-edition)**
  — ISPE's own page for the industry-practice framework behind "Category 4," "Category 5," and
  the V-model vocabulary this lesson uses. GAMP 5 is a paid publication (ISPE membership pricing
  applies), not a free regulatory document — this page is where to learn what it is and how to
  purchase or read it, not a substitute for owning a copy if your role ever requires citing it
  directly.

- **[GAMP® 5 Guide, 2nd Edition: Top Takeaways](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=fL8gBc4P0og)**
  (ISPE, from oEmbed `author_name`) — the video embedded in this lesson, published by the body
  that publishes GAMP 5. General life-sciences content, not BECS-specific, and industry practice
  rather than regulation. Verified embeddable via YouTube oEmbed on 2026-11-11 (HTTP 200).

- **[ISPE: GAMP® 5 Guide, 2nd Edition: Top Takeaways (video page)](https://ispe.org/videos/gampr-5-guide-2nd-edition-top-takeaways)**
  — ISPE's own page for the same video, with its description. Read it to see, in ISPE's words
  rather than a consultancy's, why the Second Edition stresses critical thinking by people who
  understand the system. Verified loading via `curl` on 2026-11-11 (HTTP 200).

- **[Qualio: The 10 key changes in GAMP 5 Second Edition](https://www.qualio.com/blog/the-10-key-changes-in-gamp-5-second-edition)**
  — a quality-software vendor's free summary of what changed from the first edition. It is a
  commercial secondary source, so use it for orientation and a checklist of topics, never as the
  citation; the paid ISPE guide is the primary text. Verified loading via `curl` on 2026-11-11
  (HTTP 200).

- **[FDA: General Principles of Software Validation](https://www.fda.gov/regulatory-information/search-fda-guidance-documents/general-principles-software-validation)**
  — FDA's guidance on software validation, written for device manufacturers' software. Read it to
  see the regulator's own "level of confidence" framing of validation from the vendor's side of
  the fence; it is the vendor's yardstick, not Lakeshore's, and it is guidance, not regulation.
  Verified loading via `curl` on 2026-11-11 (HTTP 200).

- **[FDA: Part 11, Electronic Records; Electronic Signatures: Scope and Application](https://www.fda.gov/regulatory-information/search-fda-guidance-documents/part-11-electronic-records-electronic-signatures-scope-and-application)**
  — the 2003 guidance behind the 11.10(a) hook this lesson names in one line and module 5
  unpacks. Skim it now so module 5's enforcement-discretion point isn't a surprise. Verified
  loading via `curl` on 2026-11-11 (HTTP 200).

- **[Cornell LII: 21 CFR 606.60, Equipment](https://www.law.cornell.edu/cfr/text/21/606.60)**
  — the blood-specific equipment regulation that FDA's BECS guidance reads alongside 211.68 when
  it treats BECS as equipment. Read it to see the Part 606 side of the regulatory floor next to
  the 211.68 text this lesson quotes. Verified loading via `curl` on 2026-11-11 (HTTP 200).

## Keep learning

Not official sources — good places to learn more about GAMP, risk-based validation and the software lifecycle.

- **[Computer Software Assurance and the Critical Thinking Approach](https://ispe.org/pharmaceutical-engineering/march-april-2024/computer-software-assurance-and-critical-thinking)** (ISPE, *Pharmaceutical Engineering*) — a practitioner article on how risk-based "assurance" differs from document-heavy validation. Worth reading to see why the V-model's test effort should scale with risk. Verified loading via `curl` on 2026-11-11 (HTTP 200).
- **[Finding the Assurance in Computer Software Assurance](https://ispe.org/index.php/pharmaceutical-engineering/september-october-2024/finding-assurance-computer-software-assurance)** (ISPE, *Pharmaceutical Engineering*) — an industry-workshop write-up on how GAMP-style thinking and the newer assurance approach fit together. Good second view after the lesson. Verified loading via `curl` on 2026-11-11 (HTTP 200).
- **[Emerging Leaders Editorial: What Is GAMP & Why Is It Important?](https://ispe.org/pharmaceutical-engineering/january-february-2024/emerging-leaders-editorial-what-gampr-why-it)** (ISPE, *Pharmaceutical Engineering*) — a short, plain-language introduction to what GAMP is for. A quick refresher before the software categories. Verified loading via `curl` on 2026-11-11 (HTTP 200).
- **[CISSP Domain 8 MindMap: Secure Software Development](https://destcert.com/resources/secure-software-development-mindmap-cissp-domain-8/)** (Destination Certification, commercial CISSP training) — a one-page map of the software development lifecycle and how security fits in, with a companion video ([Secure Software Development MindMap (1 of 2) | CISSP Domain 8](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=t-CXqjxJn_I)). Supports **CISSP Domain 8 (Software Development Security)** and gives a second vocabulary for the same lifecycle. Page verified via `curl` (HTTP 200); video verified via YouTube oEmbed on 2026-11-11 (HTTP 200).
